title: OpenBrick3D process profile
description: What a manufacturing process can resolve (profiles/process/*.json, .obprofile.json). Read by openbrick-print as ProcessProfile with camelCase fields; see docs/plan/05 section 3. Validator thresholds come from these values. Unknown fields are rejected because serde would silently drop them.

experimental.description: Experimental processes may break the minFeature = 2 x lineWidth rule and carry no clutch data yet.

layerHeightMm.description: Supported layer heights, finest first or in any order.

wallQuantiseMm.description: Walls are rounded to multiples of this (usually the line width).

minFeatureMm.description: Smallest printable stroke or detail; rule FEATURE.MIN and the morphological opening of artwork use it.

minFeatureRule.description: Human-readable derivation of minFeatureMm, for example 2 x lineWidthMm.

minTubeWallMm.description: Thinnest underside tube wall after fit offsets (rule TUBE.WALL).

minCavityDepthMm.description: Cavity depth a deboss must leave so studs below still enter (rule CAVITY.DEPTH).

maxOverhangDeg.description: Steepest printable overhang in degrees from vertical.

firstLayerChamferMm.description: Bottom-edge chamfer against elephant's foot; 0 for processes without it.

wallRoofFilletMm.description: Inner wall-to-roof fillet radius by body kind (the body.* ops).

horizontalHoleStrategy.description: How horizontal Technic holes are compensated (docs/plan/05 section 6).

horizontalHoleStrategies.description: Strategies this process can use; horizontalHoleStrategy is the default.

tessellation.description: Mesh resolution defaults for this process.

studSegments.description: Segments per full circle of a stud.

positiveMm.description: A length in millimetres greater than zero.

nonNegativeMm.description: A length in millimetres, zero or more.

holeStrategy.description: polyhole: polygon with corrected circumradius; ellipse: slightly taller hole; teardrop: pointed ceiling, no overhang.

pragma.description: Schema version pragma: major 1 and a minor, optionally a patch (docs/plan/08 sections 1 and 9). Readers accept every 1.x.

spdx.description: An SPDX licence id, or a simple AND, OR or WITH expression of ids (LICENSE-POLICY.md).

credit.description: Who made the document. Keeping it is a community norm, not a legal condition (LICENSE-POLICY.md).

provenance.description: Where the data came from, so attribution travels with it through conversion, export and printing (LICENSE-POLICY.md, docs/plan/06 section 2).

source.description: original, or the upstream file or project the data derives from.

profileId.description: A profile id: lower-case words joined by hyphens, where a word may hold dots, as in fdm-0.4 or resin-msla (docs/plan/05 section 3).
